name: 17257 · Shippensburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17257 (Shippensburg) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17257 (Shippensburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17257 (Shippensburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
